Hush removes background noise from voice recordings, entirely on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.

**Install:** download `Hush-*.apk` below, open it, and allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. Needs Android 10 or newer.

**What it does**
- Removes fan noise, AC, hiss and room tone with a speech-aware estimator that keeps voices natural
- Finds and notches out 50 Hz or 60 Hz mains hum and its harmonics
- Steady and Changing noise modes, plus "Learn from selection" to use a noise-only stretch as the reference
- Before/after spectrograms with instant A/B listening and section looping
- Opens audio and video files (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, MP4 and more)
- Saves a lossless 24-bit WAV to Downloads/Hush
